description: This file implements a custom, minimal, and reentrant version of printf family functions tailored for environments with limited stack and static buffers, likely for embedded systems or specific porting scenarios. It focuses on printing characters directly, without relying on standard library buffering, aiming to replace standard libc printf functionalities while being compatible with POSIX and custom file descriptors.

methods.name: int fputc(int c,FILE * file)
methods.description: Outputs a character to a file stream, directly using the write() system call.

methods.name: int fputs(const char * s,FILE * file)
methods.description: Outputs a null-terminated string to a file stream by repeatedly calling fputc.

methods.name: int fgetc(FILE * file)
methods.description: Reads a single character from a file stream using a blocking read.

methods.name: int fgets(char * str,int n,FILE * file)
methods.description: Reads data from a file stream until EOF or a newline is encountered, or until buffer is full.

methods.name: int printf(const char * format,...)
methods.description: Standard printf that calls vfprintf writing to stdout.

methods.name: int fprintf(FILE * file,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Prints formatted output to a specified file stream.

methods.name: int sprintf(char * buffer,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Stores formatted data into a buffer, supporting large buffers (via ~(size_t)0).

methods.name: int snprintf(char * buffer,size_t n,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Stores formatted data into a buffer with specified maximum size.

methods.name: int vprintf(const char * format,va_list ap)
methods.description: Variadic version of printf that outputs to stdout.

methods.name: int vsprintf(char * buffer,const char * format,va_list ap)
methods.description: Stores formatted data into a buffer with support for large buffer sizes.

methods.name: int vfprintf(FILE * file,const char * format,va_list ap)
methods.description: Prints formatted data to a specific file stream, using a va_list.

methods.name: int vsnprintf(char * buffer,size_t n,const char * format,va_list ap)
methods.description: Stores formatted data into a buffer with size limit, handling va_list.

methods.name: int print(FILE * file,char ** buffer,size_t n,const char * format,va_list ap)
methods.description: Core formatted printing function optimized for size and reentrancy, handles various format specifiers.

methods.name: int emitChar(FILE * file,char ** buf,char c,int * left)
methods.description: Outputs a single character either via putc to stdout or into a buffer.

methods.name: void emitString(FILE * file,char ** buffer,char * string,int width,int flags,int * left)
methods.description: Outputs a string with padding and alignment to buffer or stream.

methods.name: void emitInt(FILE * file,char ** buffer,int val,int base,int width,int flags,int * left)
methods.description: Converts an integer to string and emits it with formatting options.

methods.name: void xtoa(unsigned long val,char * str,int base,int negative)
methods.description: Converts an unsigned long value to a string with a specified base, for testing purposes.

ctags.name: emitChar
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int emitChar( FILE *file, char **buf, char c, int *left ) {$/

ctags.name: emitInt
ctags.pattern: /^void emitInt( FILE *file, char **buffer, int val, int base, int width, int flags, int *left )$/
ctags.signature: (FILE * file,char ** buffer,int val,int base,int width,int flags,int * left)

ctags.name: emitString
ctags.pattern: /^static void emitString( FILE *file, char **buffer, char *string, int width, int flags, int *left/
ctags.signature: (FILE * file,char ** buffer,char * string,int width,int flags,int * left)

ctags.name: print
ctags.pattern: /^int print(FILE *file, char **buffer, size_t n, const char *format, va_list ap)$/
ctags.signature: (FILE * file,char ** buffer,size_t n,const char * format,va_list ap)

ctags.name: vsnprintf
ctags.pattern: /^int vsnprintf(char *buffer, size_t n, const char *format, va_list ap) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^void xtoa( unsigned long val, char* str, int base, int negative) {$/
